text:
If you're under 25 and still waiting to feel ready, read this.

You will never feel ready.

Success is two halves. The first is knowing what to do. That's free, it's everywhere.

The second is the hunger inside you. The part no course sells and no guru gives away.

Without that hunger, the best advice in the world sits in your saved folder collecting dust.

Stop waiting for the moment. Become the man who makes it.

Readiness is a lie. Hunger is the truth.
caption:
Self improvement only works for men with the right mindset. Discipline without hunger is just going through the motions.

Send this to a man who needs it today.

#motivation #success #masculinity #successmindset #strongmindset
